releaseRule: The application may be marked FINAL_APP_READY only when the Mass subsystem remains certified, all app-level blockers are closed, the modular shell owns visible six-destination navigation, and the required cross-domain phone journey passes against actual index.html.
requiredPhoneJourney: cold launch -> Home -> Calendar -> Mass selection -> native LIVE -> leave/resume -> PRAY -> Home -> Settings

findings.detail: R17 native Mass is a certified subsystem and is not an app-convergence blocker.
The complete certified special-structure scope has actual-index phone-Chromium evidence.
The Prayer Book aria-hidden/focused-descendant regression is explicitly exercised without Chromium blocked-aria-hidden warnings.
AO_APP_SHELL_V1 adopts the production six-destination ribbon, strips legacy ribbon click ownership, and owns visible navigation state while preserving donor-backed destination rendering.

Actual index.html passes the required phone/touch journey from cold Home through Calendar and native LIVE, including interrupted reload at an active Mass, exact-section resume, cancelled and confirmed leave, PRAY, Home and Settings, with zero legacy Mass starts.

The modular app shell owns active-Mass ribbon suppression, forced haptics-off, structural-setting lockout, and focus-safe ribbon hiding using native-reader presence as well as the historical LIVE route.

Required live-session protections are now owned and phone-tested by src/app/live-session-guards.js. The blocker remains open only until the embedded v43.33 emergency runtime is physically removed from production index.html and the assembled-app regression suite remains green.

Production index.html contains exactly one Mass browser-entry module include. The obsolete inline icon bridge is removed; the modular Mass browser entry resolves the host icon bank directly, and production-tree hygiene regression-locks both invariants.

Calendar presentation ownership is extracted and phone-certified. Home and PRAY top-level navigation ownership are modular and actual-index phone-certified. Home card presentation (including Coming Up and Daily Catechism), PRAY presentation/recitation grammar, Learn and Settings still depend on locked non-Mass donor presentation owners.

Actual-index phone acceptance proves cold state, active-Mass checkpointing, reload without auto-reactivation, explicit resume at the saved section, preservation of form/mode/posture/gesture/language preferences, intentional suspension, and isolation of unrelated local state.
